name: io.github.Ozymandias-Owens-2/scrapewright
title: scrapewright
description: Give it a URL, get structured rows. A model writes the parser once; replays are free.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your scrapewright API key. Free at https://scrapewright.app — 1,000 rows a month, no card.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server, the model client and spreadsheet export are optional extras; the bare package cannot start the server.

packageArguments.description: scrapewright is a CLI first; `mcp` is the subcommand that speaks the protocol.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed for sites on no known platform, where a recipe has to be written once. Shopify and WooCommerce stores work without it.

environmentVariables.name: SCRAPEWRIGHT_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Where compiled recipes are kept. Point it at durable storage, or every restart pays to work the same sites out again. Defaults to ~/.scrapewright/recipes.json

environmentVariables.name: SCRAPEWRIGHT_OBEY_ROBOTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to ignore robots.txt. Only reasonable on sites you own or have written permission for; the default is to obey.
